title: Data Engineer
description:

seeking a motivated Junior Data Scientist with Data Engineering skills to join our tech clients analytics and engineering teams. This is an exciting opportunity for recent graduates or early-career professionals who are passionate about data, machine learning, and building scalable data pipelines. You will work on projects that combine data science, data engineering, and DevOps practices to deliver actionable insights and enterprise-grade solutions for U.S.-based clients.
Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines and scalable data workflows
